newsitem.title: BELGIUM: France sees deficit/GDP ratio at 2.3 pct in 1999.
newsitem.headline: France sees deficit/GDP ratio at 2.3 pct in 1999.

text.p: France expects its budget deficit to decline to 2.3 percent of gross domestic product in 1999 falling to 1.8 in the year 2000 and 1.4 percent in 2001, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The figures were included in an economic convergence programme presented in Brussels earlier on Monday.
The deficit is forecast to fall to 2.8 percent of GDP in 1998 from a targeted 3.0 percent in 1997.
The convergence programme assumes growth of 2.3 percent in 1997, and 2.5 percent per year thereafter to 2001. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800 Myra MacDonald
